tracks.algorithm: 440.0 Hz sine at 0.5 FS, 44.1 kHz/16-bit, 2.0 s; ends at (near) a zero crossing
880.0 Hz sine at 0.5 FS, 96 kHz/24-bit, 2.0 s; starts exactly at a zero crossing; forces a controlled tuple reconfiguration

end_impulse.algorithm: exactly 1.0 s of digital silence; a single full-scale (+FS) impulse on the final sample of both channels; any tail truncation removes it

nonzero_final_samples.algorithm: 220.1 Hz sine at 0.5 FS, both channels identical, exactly 2.0 s; ends abruptly while the waveform is still near its peak (final phase 0.2 cycle, |last sample| > 0.25 FS)

tracks.algorithm: 440.0 Hz sine at 0.5 FS, both channels identical, 2.0 s; ends at (near) a zero crossing so the track itself adds no click
880.0 Hz sine at 0.5 FS, both channels identical, 2.0 s; starts exactly at a zero crossing so the track itself adds no click

generator: stdlib-only deterministic generation; algorithms recorded per fixture
hash_convention: the R35 entry fixture_sha256 is sha256 over the ordered concatenation of the fixture tracks; for a single track it equals the file sha256; for the boundary fixtures it is recomputable with `cat A B | sha256sum`
kernel_note: device-independent fixtures generated before the physical R35 campaign; reusable by both DAC campaigns by path and hash

procedure.different_tuple_two_track_boundary: two media in one lab invocation (A=44.1/16 then B=96/24); observe a clean controlled reconfiguration with a fresh generation and no gap, click or stale fragment
procedure.end_impulse: single media; the final full-scale impulse must be audible at the very end; its absence is tail truncation
procedure.nonzero_final_samples: single media; listen for the tone stopping cleanly with no audible tail cutoff; falsifiers: tail_truncated, stale_samples_after_application_pointer
procedure.same_tuple_two_track_boundary: two media in one lab invocation (A then B, same tuple); both tracks are click-free by construction, so any gap or click at the boundary is teardown-induced; falsifiers: extra_drain_gap_between_same_tuple_tracks, click_pop_introduced_by_teardown
